_readme: Every package in package-lock.json that declares an install script, reviewed once and
pinned here so a NEW one cannot arrive unnoticed inside 280KB of lockfile diff.
Why this matters on this repo specifically: scripts/deploy-api.sh runs `npm ci` on the
droplet as www-data, on the box that also serves the team's WordPress and MySQL. A
postinstall in the production closure is arbitrary code execution as the web user,
there. That is the whole npm supply-chain attack shape, and you do not have to be
compromised for it to land — only something you transitively depend on.
Two mitigations are in place today (.npmrc ignore-scripts=true, and an explicit
--ignore-scripts on the remote npm ci) and the check asserts both, because this
allowlist is what is left if either one is removed.
`inProdClosure` is recorded, not just the name. A package moving from dev-only into the
production closure changes WHO runs its script and on WHICH machine, which is a change
worth seeing even though the package itself was already known.

allowed.name: esbuild
allowed.why: postinstall (node install.js) swaps the JS bin shim for the native binary. lib/main.js resolves @esbuild/<platform> at runtime without it. Dev-only since tsx left package.json dependencies (2026-09-22); it no longer reaches the droplet.

allowed.name: fsevents
allowed.why: macOS-only optional dependency, dev-only in the lockfile and irrelevant on the Linux droplet either way. Native build step only.

allowed.name: unrs-resolver
allowed.why: dev-only, via eslint-config-next. Loads @unrs/resolver-binding-<platform> at runtime; the postinstall is a convenience.

allowed.name: fsevents
allowed.why: dev-only copy under playwright. Same macOS watcher as the top-level entry.

guards.npmrcIgnoreScripts: ignore-scripts=true must stay in .npmrc — it is rsync'd to /opt/ib-api and covers a hand-run npm ci on the droplet.
guards.deployIgnoreScripts: scripts/deploy-api.sh must keep passing --ignore-scripts to the remote npm ci, so the protection does not depend on .npmrc having arrived intact.
